name: Healing Helps
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, so all engagement is coming organically through Google Business Profile, which drove 36 total actions including 2 calls, 16 direction requests, and 18 website clicks. The biggest movement is a 42% week-over-week lift in GA4 activity, likely reflecting increased organic interest, while GBP actions dropped 100% in the last 7 days, suggesting a sudden falloff in profile visibility or engagement that warrants immediate attention.

performance.verdict: No paid activity exists; organic signal is deteriorating fast.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads are completely dark. No CPL or leads exist to evaluate efficiency.
GBP actions dropped -100% in last 7 days; last 3 days (Sep 4–6) show 0 actions vs 0-1 in prior 3 — a confirmed zero-activity streak.
GA4 sessions 3-day signal (Sep 4–6): 10+3+2 = 15 vs prior 3 (Sep 1–3): 28+9+6 = 43 — a 65% drop, reversing the 42% 7d lift the daily verdict celebrated.
GBP actions peaked at 11 on Aug 25 then collapsed to 0 for 12 straight days — structural drop, not noise, with no paid support to compensate.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP profile immediately — 12 consecutive zero-action days since Aug 26 indicates a visibility or suspension issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP has recorded 0 actions for 12 consecutive days (Aug 26–Sep 6), down from a peak of 11 on Aug 25. Check for profile suspension, category changes, or Q&A/review spam flags that may have suppressed visibility. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to the Aug 10–14 baseline of 3–4 per day. Re-check by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions daily — 3-day total of 15 vs 43 prior 3 days signals organic interest is now reversing; re-check Sep 10.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions fell from a 3-day total of 43 (Sep 1–3) to 15 (Sep 4–6), a 65% drop that contradicts the 42% weekly lift flagged this morning. Monitor daily session counts through Sep 10 — if they remain below 5/day for 3 more days, this confirms a structural organic decline tied to the GBP outage in F2. No paid action is warranted until the organic floor is understood.
